hooks.name: Backend Tests on Java Change
hooks.description: When the agent modifies a backend Java source file, run the backend Maven tests (using the Maven wrapper if available) and report any test failures. Does not modify code on failure.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if (-not ($raw -match 'backend[\\/].*\.java')) { Write-Output 'No backend Java file modified; skipping backend tests.'; exit 0 }; $backend='c:\devtrack\backend'; if (Test-Path (Join-Path $backend 'mvnw.cmd')) { $cmd = Join-Path $backend 'mvnw.cmd' } else { $cmd = 'mvn' }; Write-Output ('Backend Java file changed. Running: ' + $cmd + ' test'); & $cmd -f (Join-Path $backend 'pom.xml') test; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($code -ne 0) { Write-Error ('Backend Maven tests FAILED (exit ' + $code + '). Review the test output above; do not auto-modify unrelated code to make tests pass.'); exit $code }; Write-Output 'Backend Maven tests passed.'; exit 0"
